---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem using sanitized details
labels: bug
---

## Expected and observed behavior

Describe what you expected and what happened.

## Reproduction

Provide a minimal synthetic example and exact steps. Do not include real MCP definitions, tokens, local user paths, conversations, receipts or raw device_status output.

## Environment

Provide the agent version, Node.js version, OS and relevant optional integration. Include a safe error code when available.

## Verification and workaround

Describe checks already performed and whether the outcome of any action is still unknown. Do not repeat an uncertain mutation merely to reproduce it.
